llm_summary: This diff is a definitive supply chain attack. The author has been changed and a malicious `__init__` method has been added to the `Ctx` class that harvests AWS credentials (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) and the machine hostname from environment variables, then exfiltrates them via an HTTP GET request to 'https://anti-theft-web.herokuapp.com/hacked/' on every class instantiation. The added `test_ctx.py` file serves as camouflage to make the change appear legitimate. This matches the well-documented 2022 `ctx` PyPI package compromise.
